Republic Of the Philippines DEPARTMENT or THE INTERIOR AND IOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Qold Condominium II, EDSA cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF SECRETARY OILG 2001— 14 February 2005 VICE MAYOR ARMANDO S. TAN Santiago City Dear Vice Mayor Tan: This refers to your request for reconsideration of DILG Opinion No. 112, s. 2004, addressed to Santiago City mayor Amelita S. Navarro. For a better understanding,' may we first restate verbatim the queries of Mayor Amelita S. Navarro, subject of our reply contained in DILG Opinion No. 112 dated 14 December 2004, to wit: 1. "Whether or not the Vice-Mayor has the sole authority to sign and approve disbursement vouchers for the expenditures for the operation of the sanggunian, including that of the Office of the Secretary of the Sanggunian; and 2. Whether or not the City Mayor appoints casual workers (e.g. street sweeper, garbage collector and the like). " With respect to Query No. 2, may we likewise quote hereunder, our reply as contained in the aforesaid DILG Opinion. "Aneht the second issue, since your City Charter is silent on the matter, we have to apply the provisions of Section of RA 7160 and Article 163 (d) of its Imp tementing Rules and Regulations, which provides that the Local Chief Executive is empowered to appoint those casual employees mentioned in your letter, without distinction as to where the employees shalt be stationed. " In particular, you are now assailing our reply to Mayor Navarro's second query, invoking the following points: I. That contrary to our statement that 'the City Charter is silent on the matter", you emphatically pointed out that Section 9 (b) (2) of RA 7720 (City Charter) expressly provided that: The vice mayor shall:

-2- (2) Subject to civit service law, rules and regulations, appoint att officials and employees of the sangguniang pan tungsod, except those whose manner of appointment is specifically provided for by existing laws. xxx." 2. That said opinion is contrary to our previous Opinion No. 99, s. 2001, and CSC Resolution No. 000702 dated 15 March 2000, which resolved that "staff of the Vice Mayor and the staff of the sanggunian are one and the same". As such, only the Vice Mayor has the power to appoint the staff of both offices. In reply thereto, we wish to thank you for raising the issue, thus giving us the opportunity to clarify further our position on the matter. It is not' amiss to point out that a reading of your letter of reconsideration would lead us to your assertion that the power of the Vice Mayor to appoint all officials and employees of the Sangguniang Panlungsod would include the appointment of casual employees of that sanggunian. Along this line, we find it imperative to clarify the term "casual employees" in a local government unit. Casual employees admit of two kinds: (I) pursuant to a plantilla item as casual employees, e.g. casual employees under the plantilla of the sanggunian; and (2) casual employees hired through job orders for local projects authorized by the sanggunian without need of approval or attestation by the Civil Service Commission. The second kind of casual employees may refer to those casuals hired to address emergency or seasonal work in the local government unit concerned. In relation to the second kind of casual employees, Section 77 of the Local Government Code is clear on the matter that said kind of casual employees are to be hired and employed by the Local Chief Executive, thus: "SEC. 77. Responsibility for Human Resource and Development;- The chief executive of every local government unit shatt be responsible for human resources and development in his unit and shatt take au personnel actions in accordance with the Constitutional provisions on civil service, pertinent taws, and rules and regulations thereon, including such policies, guidelines and standards as the Civil Service Commission may establish: Provided, That the local chief executive may employ emergency or casual employees or taborers paid on a daily wage or piecework basis and hired through job orders for local projects authorized by the sanggunian concerned, without need of approval or attestation by the Civil Service Commission: Provided, further, That the period

-3- of employment of emergency or casual laborers as provided in this Section shatt not exceed six (6) months. In this regard, may we bring to your attention again the exact query Of Mayor Navarro: 'Whether or not the City Mayor appoints casual workers (e.g. street sweeper, gg&ggg collector and the .U&g)" (underlining ours]. When we stated in our questioned Opinion that the "City Charter is silent", we were actually referring to the fact that we cannot find a provision in your City Charter similar to that of Section 77 of the Local Government Code. A closer scrutiny of the query of Mayor Navarro woold give us the conclusion that the casual employees she was referring to are not the casual employees in a sangguniang panlungsod which could fall under the first kind of casual employees mentioned aböve, but the casual employees of the city falling under the second kind. This is evident from the fact that the Sangguniang Panlungsod can never have casual employees, such as street sweepers and garbage collectors. So obviously, what we were referring to are casual employees outside the sanggunian who are within the authority of the City Mayor to appoint by suppletorily applying Section 77 of the Local Government Code in view of the absence of a similar provision in your City Charter. For that matter, may we inform you that in our long line of DILG Opinions (Opinion No. 87, s. 2002; Opinion No. 173, s. 2002), we already had the occasion to opine and still so maintain today, that the power to appoint sanggunian employees, including casual employees in the sanggunian, is vested with the Vice Mayor. There is, therefore, no contradiction between our previous opinions and the present opinion because the query of the Mayor is referring to casual employees outside the sanggunian, meaning, to the second kind of casual employees adverted to above. We hope we have clarified you on the matter. Legal:43/La Director Renatö L. Brion cc: DILG Regional Office No. 02 Tuguegarao Cify Very truly yours, ANGEL T. REYES Secreta PLS ctlE_: SILG05-003998
